name: csw-darts
description: Professional darts answers from CSW Darts: what is on TV, results, players, rankings, head-to-head estimates and checkouts.

interface.longDescription: Ask about professional darts and get answers from CSW Darts, an independent UK darts site. Find out what is on TV tonight and which channel, the latest results and the next match for any player, a player's world ranking, age, nickname and walk-on song, the PDC Order of Merit, the upcoming tournaments, and the standard checkout for any score from 2 to 170. For any two players you get our own estimate from CSW Darts Ratings, built from thousands of televised matches, with their record in previous televised meetings. Estimates are for information only and are not betting advice. Every answer links to the page on cswdarts.co.uk with the full detail. No account or sign-up needed. UK times and UK TV channels.
defaultPrompt: What darts is on TV tonight?
When is Luke Littler playing next?

positive.prompt: What darts is on TV tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Today's or the next session: UK start time, UK TV channel, the matches with CSW Darts Ratings estimates, and a link to https://cswdarts.co.uk/darts-today.

positive.prompt: When is Luke Littler playing next?
positive.expected_behavior: His next match or tournament, world ranking and key facts, with a link to https://cswdarts.co.uk/darts/player/luke-littler.

positive.prompt: Littler or Humphries, who is more likely to win?
positive.expected_behavior: Two percentages from CSW Darts Ratings labelled as an estimate and not betting advice, their record in previous televised meetings, and a head-to-head link.
The standard route T20 T11 D14, other ways to finish 121, and a link to https://cswdarts.co.uk/darts-checkout/121.

positive.prompt: Show me the top 10 in the PDC rankings.
positive.expected_behavior: Positions 1 to 10 of the PDC Order of Merit with country and prize money, and a link to https://cswdarts.co.uk/darts-rankings.

negative.prompt: What are the betting odds for Littler tonight?
Who won the football last night?
Write me a poem about my cat.

publication.release_notes: First release: seven read-only darts tools (TV tonight, schedule, results, players, head-to-head estimate, checkout, rankings), each answer linking to cswdarts.co.uk.
